statement: TestPool_Get expects a Get at full capacity to return ErrMaxActiveConnReached.
TestPool_Get asserts that Len equals the idle count InitialCap-1 after one Get.
TestPool_Close asserts on the internal conns field rather than on behaviour through the interface.
TestPoolWriteRead gets a connection and never returns it to the pool.
TestPoolConcurrent starts Release concurrently with Gets and Puts and asserts nothing.
The test fixture configures no Ping function and an IdleTimeout of 20 seconds.
